summary: FINAVERE AS (org. no. 936 219 136) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2025-09-22. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 00.000 (Uoppgitt); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 27 367. Board chair: Jan Gunnar Haga; auditor: CROWE STAVANGER REVISJON AS.
